He found him in a desert land,
He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’

The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against Yahweh their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;
He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.
If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men?
He builds his house as the moth,
The wicked walk on every side,
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,
Be strong, and let your heart take courage,
You are my hiding place.
Depart from evil, and do good.
For innumerable evils have surrounded me.
So I will sing praise to your name forever,
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked,
that they might set their hope in God,
that they might keep his statutes,
Blessed are those who keep his statutes,
Take reproach and contempt away from me,
Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes.
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law.
This is my way,
The proud have smeared a lie upon me.
I understand more than the aged,
Depart from me, you evildoers,
Your testimonies are wonderful,
I have called with my whole heart.

My son, let them not depart from your eyes.

that you may maintain discretion,

Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute,

I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry,
